records.jp: ふぅ……
records.en_original: *sigh*...
records.en_auxiliary: *Sigh*

records.jp: お疲れさま、ヒナちゃん
records.en_original: Impressive work, Hina.
records.en_auxiliary: Impressive work, Hina.

records.jp: ちーちゃんのところに行こう！
records.en_original: Now we can go check on Chii!
records.en_auxiliary: Now we can go check on Chii!

records.jp: ライムはパス
records.en_original: Yeah, I'll pass.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah, I'll pass.

records.jp: ライム！
records.en_original: Lime!
records.en_auxiliary: Lime!

records.jp: だって、もうフラグメントは固定化できたんだから、<CR>あとは指輪をしてもらうだけでしょ？
records.en_original: Well, we've solidified her Fragment already, so we just need her to put on the ring, right?
records.en_auxiliary: Well, we've stabilized her Fragment already, so we just need her to put on the ring, right?
records.en: We've already stabilized the Fragment,<CR>so all that's left is to have her put on the ring, right?

records.jp: それじゃあ、ちーちゃんの気持ちは！？<CR>こんなことになって、きっとすごく苦しんでるよ！
records.en_original: But what about her feelings!? She has to be hurting after all that's happened today!
records.en_auxiliary: But what about her feelings?! She has to be hurting after all that's happened today!
records.en: But what about Chii-chan's feelings!?<CR>She must be suffering after everything that's happened!

records.jp: だから何？　あの子の悩みを聞いてあげたらフラグメントが<CR>もっと強くなるの？
records.en_original: So what? Is the Fragment going to get any more powerful if I listen to her woes?
records.en_auxiliary: So what? Is the Fragment going to get any more powerful if I listen to her woes?
records.en: So what? Will the Fragment get any stronger<CR>if we listen to her problems?

records.jp: ……話しても平行線だね
records.en_original: ...This conversation is done.
records.en_auxiliary: ...This conversation is over.

records.jp: ライム！
records.en_original: Wait, Lime!
records.en_auxiliary: Wait, Lime!

records.jp: 私はこんなやり方……好きじゃないから
records.en_original: I really don't like the way you're going about this...
records.en_auxiliary: I really don't like the way you're going about this...
records.en: I really don't like the way you're going about this...

records.jp: ライムはライムの方法でヒナちゃんを助ける
records.en_original: Well, I'll just find my own way to help you then, Hina.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm just helping you out in my own way, Hina.
records.en: Lime will help you in Lime's own way, Hina-chan.

records.jp: 手段を選んでられるほど、ライムたちに時間はないから
records.en_original: But we don't have the time to be picking over our methods.
records.en_auxiliary: We don't have time to be picky about our methods.
records.en: Lime and the others don't have enough time to be choosy about their methods.

records.jp: 行こう、千紘のところに
records.en_original: Come on, Yuzu. Chihiro needs us.
records.en_auxiliary: Come on, Yuzu. Chihiro needs us.

records.jp: ごめんね、ヒナちゃん
records.en_original: I'm so sorry, Hina.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm so sorry, Hina.

records.jp: ううん。大丈夫
records.en_original: Don't be. We're fine.
records.en_auxiliary: Don't be. It's fine.

records.jp: 日菜子……さん
records.en_original: Hinako...
records.en_auxiliary: Hinako...

records.jp: 千紘！　あの子たちは？
records.en_original: Chihiro! Where are the other girls?
records.en_auxiliary: Chihiro! Where are the other girls?
records.en: Chihiro! Where are the other girls?

records.jp: 具合悪そう……だったから……保健室に……
records.en_original: They seemed unwell...so they...went to the nurse's office...
records.en_auxiliary: They seemed unwell...so they...went to the nurse's office...
records.en: They seemed unwell...so they...went to the nurse's office...

records.jp: そっか……
records.en_original: Oh.
records.en_auxiliary: Oh.

records.jp: わたしの……せいで……
records.en_original: It was...my fault...
records.en_auxiliary: It was...my fault...

records.jp: わたしが……上手くやれてたら<CR>誰も……傷つかなかった
records.en_original: If I'd been more careful...nobody would've gotten hurt....
records.en_auxiliary: If I'd been more careful...nobody would've gotten hurt...
records.en: If I'd handled it better,<CR>no one would have been hurt...

records.jp: 何度も……止めようとした……けど、<CR>怖くて……声……かけられなくて……
records.en_original: I tried...to say something, so many times... But...I was scared. I couldn't say anything...
records.en_auxiliary: I tried...to say something, so many times... But...I was scared. I couldn't say anything...
records.en: I tried...to stop her so many times...<CR>But I was scared...and couldn't...say anything...

records.jp: （そうか。<CR>千紘は犯人の子に、自分から盗むのをやめてほしかったんだ）
records.en_original: (I think I get it now. Chihiro must have wanted the thief's conscience to get her to stop stealing.)
records.en_auxiliary: (I think I get it now. Chihiro must have wanted the thief's conscience to get her to stop stealing.)
records.en: (I see.<CR>Chihiro wanted that girl to stop stealing of her own accord.)

records.jp: （こんな風にみんながいがみ合わないですむように。<CR>今回のことをなかったことにしたかった。だから犯人をかばって）
records.en_original: (In order to keep those girls from fighting over it. She took the blame and gave them a common enemy...)
records.en_auxiliary: (In order to keep those girls from fighting, she took the blame and gave them a common enemy...)
records.en: (She wanted to keep everyone from fighting like this.<CR>She wanted the whole incident to disappear. That's why she covered for the culprit.)

records.jp: わたしの……せいで……
records.en_original: It was...all my fault...
records.en_auxiliary: It was...all my fault...

records.jp: ……それは違うんじゃない？
records.en_original: ...I don't think so.
records.en_auxiliary: ...I don't think so.

records.en_original: Huh...?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh...?

records.jp: 私も、みんなが仲良くできたらそれが一番だと思う
records.en_original: I think you're right to hope that everyone could get along.
records.en_auxiliary: I think you're right to hope that everyone could get along.
records.en: I also think it would be best if everyone could get along.

records.jp: でも、みんなそれぞれ他人なんだし、<CR>思ったとおりになるわけじゃない
records.en_original: But we're all different individuals and the only person's behavior we can control is our own.
records.en_auxiliary: But we're all different individuals, and the only person's behavior we can control is our own.
records.en: But everyone is their own person,<CR>so things won't always go the way you want.

records.jp: 上手くいかないのを全部、自分のせいだと思うのは、<CR>逆に身勝手だよ
records.en_original: And to put the blame on yourself when people don't act the way you hoped they would is almost...selfish.
records.en_auxiliary: And to put the blame on yourself when people don't act the way you hoped they would is almost...selfish.
records.en: Blaming yourself for everything that doesn't go well<CR>is actually selfish.

records.jp: 思いどおりにはならないけど、少しずつでも、失敗しながらでも、<CR>変えていこうとする気持ちが大事なんじゃないかな
records.en_original: Mistakes happen. Things don't always go according to plan. What's important is wanting things to change for the better.
records.en_auxiliary: Mistakes happen. Things don't always go according to plan. What's important is wanting things to change for the better.
records.en: Things won't always go the way you want. But even if change comes little by little, even if you make mistakes,<CR>I think what matters is that you keep trying.

records.jp: えっと、だから……
records.en_original: Umm, okay, this is getting complicated, what I mean is...
records.en_auxiliary: Umm, okay, this is getting complicated. What I mean is...

records.jp: こんなところで自分を責めてないでさ、<CR>次はどうすればいいか、考えよう！
records.en_original: Don't blame yourself when things go wrong, just think about what to do next!
records.en_auxiliary: Don't blame yourself when things go wrong, just think about what to do next!
records.en: Instead of standing here blaming yourself,<CR>let's think about what to do next!

records.jp: 一緒にさ
records.en_original: ...With your friends.
records.en_auxiliary: ...With your friends.

records.jp: ！　……うん
records.en_original: ! <CR>...Okay.
records.en_auxiliary: ...Okay!
